thread:
kevin: quick thought - our fallback telemetry is very chatty. proposal: emit a compact fallback event per degraded request + keep full traces sampled for internal audits. expose a public `fallback_reason` enum (latency_quota, model_error, overcapacity, policy_quarantine) but strip host/node internals. feedback?

nina: exposing reason enums could leak routing behavior. need privacy/compliance check.

kevin: agree. public events should only carry enums, route name, timestamp, and a short prompt_hash. full traces with node ids/kv state are internal and sampled.

sam: +1. sketch of compact event: ```json
{
  "event_type": "fallback_compact",
  "customer_id": "cust_ABC",
  "reason": "overcapacity",
  "route": "text-gen-prod",
  "lite_id": "s-xyz01",
  "prompt_hash": "7f3a...",
  "ts": 4987654329
}
```

sam: also propose per-customer sampling policy: baseline 0.1%, auto-bump to 1% for anomaly windows, emergency cap to 5% but gated. store full traces in internal logstore with 30d retention.

maria: Console UX idea - show aggregated "fallbacks by reason" histogram and a "view sampled traces" button. operator-only forensic view should link sampled traces to rollout events and policy versions.

nina: auditors may request full lists for specific windows. if we sample, we need a deterministic replay path. include prompt_hash + model_version so we can re-run for a window with internal raw prompt access if legally required. public data remains hashes.

kevin: technical detail - compact-events go to a separate Kafka topic with per-customer throttle and a circuit-breaker. pseudoconfig: ```yaml
compact_event:
  sample_rate: 0.001
  spike_sample_rate: 0.01
  max_burst_per_minute: 2000
```

sam: implementation note - add an emergency soft-throttle to avoid event storms in incident cascades.

maria: consent flow - customers can toggle "share richer fallback telemetry" in Console to enable richer per-request reasons in their API responses and higher sampling. otherwise default keeps reason out of response. also provide an operator override for 24h escalations. add a small privacy CTA explaining what stays internal.

kevin: API exposure debate - return `fallback_reason` in response body by default or opt-in header? proposal: do not return by default. provide opt-in header `X-Redwood-Fallback-Reason: true` + Console consent. keeps surface minimal.

nina: security review + logging safeguards needed if we expose any per-request signals. I'll scope the checklist.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: created ticket INF-1428 "compact fallback telemetry + sampling + consent toggle" assigned to @sam and @maria.

kevin: next steps: sam to draft Kafka schema + PR, maria to mock Console panels and consent UX, nina to run privacy/security scoping. meet in 48h?

maria: works for me.

sam: will open WIP PR tomorrow with schema.

nina: adding security checklist to INF-1428.

kevin: thanks all. goal: minimal public footprint, full internal auditability where needed. :thumbsup:
